description: A physical piece of equipment tracked for reliability and maintenance history.

attributes.description: The equipment manufacturer (e.g. Talbrook, Meridian, Corvale, BrightAir, Sterling, Arkwell).
The manufacturer model designation (e.g. TF-40, CB-200).
The general category of asset (e.g. forklift, conveyor, dock-leveler, hvac-unit, generator, compressor).
The named zone or area where the asset is located.
The date the asset was installed or commissioned.
The procurement or install batch identifier shared with sibling assets.
